claim: Patchline ships a verified SQL parser front-end with a proof that the AST round-trips the source. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the round-trip claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verified-sql-parser-gate`.
